$comment: The one platform registry. The C# domain embeds this file and the client imports it, so adding a platform here (plus a --<id>-color token in both themes) is the whole change. A fee schedule is fee = base * percent / 100 + fixed, where base is the price alone, or price + shipping charged when includesShipping. These are only estimates: a sale with its real payout derives the fee from that instead. Order matters: it is the order platforms appear in filters, charts and the fee editor.

platforms.label: Depop
platforms.note: US: the 10% selling fee was dropped in 2024 (buyers pay it instead); what's left for the seller is payment processing on the whole order.

platforms.label: eBay
platforms.note: Final value fee for most categories, plus the per-order fixed fee.

platforms.label: Vinted
platforms.note: No seller fees — the buyer pays Buyer Protection on top.
